Los Angeles is in Pacific Time Zone (PT), which is UTC-8 during standard time and UTC-7 during daylight saving time. Berlin is in Central European Time (CET), which is UTC+1 during standard time and UTC+2 during daylight saving time. The difference depends on whether DST is in effect in each location.

We should provide the current difference. As of now, it's May 31, 2026. In the Northern Hemisphere, DST typically starts in March and ends in October. So both LA and Berlin are likely on DST. LA would be on PDT (UTC-7) and Berlin on CEST (UTC+2). The difference would be 9 hours. Berlin is ahead of Los Angeles by 9 hours.

We should confirm if any other factors apply. For example, some countries have different DST start dates. But generally, Berlin is 9 hours ahead of LA during DST. But the user asked "What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?" We can give the current difference: 9 hours ahead.
